flows.name: Register or regularize Network Element
steps: Resolve/create authoritative Site context
Create immutable Network Element identity with nonblank operational name
Optionally attach model/serial/placement/Cloud/IP facts through separately validated relationships
Optionally link one-or-more operational Device References to the Network Element
Preserve Device Reference identities and historical ticket relationships unchanged

flows.name: Physical placement
steps: Select Site
Select/create Room under that Site
Select/create Rack under that Room
Optionally record row/column/position placement semantics
Validate Rack-derived Site equals Network Element authoritative Site
Commit placement relationship/history without altering containment

flows.name: Containment correction
steps: Propose parent Network Element
Validate parent != child
Validate child has at most one current parent
Detect direct/indirect cycle
Commit accepted parent/child relationship and correction history
Do not infer Rack placement, Cloud or connectivity from containment

flows.name: Cloud assignment
steps: Select reusable Cloud Type or existing Site-scoped Cloud Deployment
Create Deployment only within one Site
Validate Network Element and Deployment share Site
Assign at most one current Deployment to the Network Element
Derive Cloud Type through Deployment

flows.name: Model compatibility and installed components
steps: Maintain reusable Model/BOM/component compatibility reference separately
Register actual installed Component instance under one Network Element when observed/known
Preserve instance-specific slot/serial/condition/chronology where applicable
On replacement/correction, preserve prior installed-instance history
Never rewrite reusable compatibility knowledge to represent one device's installed state

flows.name: Infrastructure workbook exchange
steps: Generate versioned macro-free template/export
Operator edits external workbook outside SOMA
Explicit discovery/manual selection enters HLD-05 staging
Validate version/security/identity and compute non-destructive diff
Review proposed Infrastructure mutations
HLD-09 revalidates current state and commits accepted mutations atomically
Never modify the operator-managed source workbook

projection_rules: Network Element display may derive Customer, Site, Room, Rack, Cloud Type and resolved Device Reference context from authoritative relationships.
Descriptive IPs may be displayed/searchable but do not produce topology/reachability/connectivity projections.
Reusable compatibility projections and installed-component projections must remain separately queryable.
Any future graph representation is disposable/rebuildable from SQLite authority and cannot become a write authority.
